basic_info.description:
Ideal location to enjoy all that San Francisco and the Marina has to offer!

1 bedroom with remodeled kitchen and bath, garage parking. Walk, jog or bike to Marina Green, Chestnut St., Union St. shops and restaurants. Steps to Safeway, Ft. Mason. Easy walk to Presidio, Aquatic Park, Fisherman’s Wharf, North Beach, Cable Car
* 1 block to public transportation, including express bus to financial district 
* Remodeled kitchen with new stainless appliances, granite countertops, dishwasher, built in wine rack, all appliances, dishes, utensils, glassware, etc.
* Remodeled bathroom with marble counter
* Secure, intercom-accessible building
* Coin laundry in building
* Remote-controlled garage parking for 1 vehicle
* Sorry - No pets. No smokers.
* Maximum 2 tenants
Available 4/1 
* Prefer a minimum of 12-month term.

Credit check and references required. $3800 deposit.
